name: שָׁפָן
summary: Shaphan son of Azaliah is Josiah’s scribe. Hilkiah gives him the book found in the temple, and Shaphan reads it before the king. Ezekiel names Jaazaniah’s father as Shaphan.

evidence.note: Josiah sends Shaphan son of Azaliah to the temple.
The common noun for the hyrax has the same form.

note: TIPNR lists the scribe and Jaazaniah’s father under separate keys. Ezekiel gives no genealogy identifying the father with the scribe.
